text:
sophie_ops: FRA crossdock received container with moisture alarm. Quick triage: 5 units show light corrosion, 7 units DOA at power-on. Holding rest.

raj_procure: PO# 59122 noted, did forwarder submit SDR?

elaine_logistics: yes SDR filed. Quarantine at FRA-DC7. We need HS amendment to classify as repair parts to avoid duties if we keep units in EU repair flow.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor suspects seal failure. Options: depot refurb (vendor supplies tech kits) or air replacement. Vendor will air 4 units within 4 days if we sign salvage waiver; otherwise depot route + 2% credit.

michael_sales: prefer air for critical SLAs. Can we route US spares to mask impact in the short term?

claims-bot: Insurance claim IC-2026-800 opened, adjuster Mirek assigned. Required: photos, container inspection, humidity logs, packing list, invoices.

sophie_ops: ops plan: 1) quarantine at FRA-DC7, 2) run depot bench and tag `water_contact`, 3) collect per-serial bench logs, 4) move 8 US spares to EU buffer for top customers. I'll run tests on 12 suspect units.

# depot quick bench (depot-tech):
```
power-on --unit $SERIAL --log /dc7/logs/$SERIAL.boot
inference-bench --model tinybert --seq 16 --iters 30 --timeout 90s > /dc7/logs/$SERIAL.bench
grep -E "ERR|corros|short|thermal_trip" /dc7/logs/$SERIAL.* | head -n 40
```

raj_procure: commercial ask: vendor covers return freight + conditional duty rebate if insurer denies, and provide bench logs per serial before any shipback. Escalate to commercial if vendor refuses.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor agrees to depot preflight bench logs for repaired units and will cover depot labor for first 24h. They decline salvage waiver and want credit if we demand air without insurer signoff. Offer on table: 3% credit if we accept depot route, or 3% + air for 4 units in 4 days if we accept limited commercial holdback.

michael_sales: prepping calm customer note: "Small subset of recent H200s quarantined due to transit damage. We have replacements in progress for highest-impact customers and will provide daily updates."

claims-bot: humidity sensor shows spike to 81% on 2026-03-13 03:12 UTC. Photos uploaded to IC-2026-800.

sophie_ops: starting bench runs now, will tag results and post per-serial logs. If vendor signs preflight spec, proceed with depot repair kits; otherwise hold for insurer confirmation before accepting air replacements.
